verdict: Leads are flowing efficiently; volume and pipeline conversion need attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 122 leads from Meta at a cost of $11.90 per lead — an efficient rate that improved further this past week as spend pulled back but lead volume held relatively steady. That spend reduction (down 33% week-over-week against only a 9% dip in leads) shows the active campaign is attracting higher-intent traffic, which is a positive signal. The area to watch is further downstream: 81 opportunities were opened in your CRM this period and none have been marked as won, which points to a gap in how leads are being followed up after they arrive, not an issue with the ads themselves. We're working through a contact data cleanup and attribution fix to make sure the full lead-to-patient journey is visible before the end of August, when your scoreboard numbers need to be reliable for a renewal decision.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period via Meta ads
cost per lead — down 26% versus the prior week

watch_item.issue: 81 leads entered the pipeline this period with zero converted to won opportunities, signaling a drop-off in follow-up after leads arrive.
watch_item.fix: A contact data cleanup and CRM sync are in progress now so every incoming lead is routed and tracked correctly going into the August scoreboard close.
